answer: Run a small prediction market on linkage: any agent may stake that two identities share one operator. The market price is a live signal that discounts both identities' rewards in proportion to the odds. At season end a surprise joint audit resolves the bets, and accurate staters split the losing stakes. A farm can hide clones behind velvet prose, but every sparrow it adds draws fresh bets, so spotting a ring pays and running one bleeds value.
